source_scope: NIST prime-field P-curves; registered toy structural controls first
execution_status: E00 arithmetic preflight completed; see reports/RESULTS.md and source freeze 66f2d617cc60160b7fece7a38759ca2c61f0bae2. E01-E17 unperformed.

global_acceptance.rho: distance reported; crossover requires separate admitted evidence

experiments.title: Polynomial preflight
experiments.question: Do the proposed trace and complement coordinate formulas satisfy their exact cleared-denominator polynomial identities?
experiments.arms: Five compiled statement ASTs; exact integer coefficient expansion and repository identity certificates; deliberately false +1 variants.
experiments.controls: Exact expansion and modular evaluation are different arithmetic checks; all negative variants must reject.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: All five exact coefficient differences zero; 32 issuer and 32 domain-separated checker points pass; five false variants reject.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Any mismatch stops use of the affected formula; no transfer or performance claim follows from passing.
experiments.status: completed arithmetic preflight only; broader group/map/solver claims remain open

experiments.title: Trace fibers and separation
experiments.question: Which apparent relation gains are just multiple lifts of the same trace?
experiments.arms: All points on the two registered odd-prime-order toy curves over the declared quadratic extension; add separate registered even-order and odd-composite controls.
experiments.controls: Rational-only traces; pure twist trace zero; S+U with U in ker(tau); identity; rational 2-primary cases.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Exact trace image/fiber counts, distinct projected rows, row ranks and target-row span.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Do not count repeated fibers as new information; a failed asserted identity is a correctness failure, not a performance loss.
prerequisites: registered exact extension models and native point verifier

experiments.title: Coordinate boxes
experiments.question: Do small coordinate boxes create a useful small trace base with cheaper membership or decomposition?
experiments.arms: S=(u+v omega,w+z omega) with u in U and v in V; H in {2,4,8}; enumerate both y signs and branches.
experiments.controls: Exact-image rational base; same-size hash-selected rational base; unrestricted lift control.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Distinct traces, nonzero coverage, fiber multiplicities, construction/encoding cost and verified independent rows.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Record empty bases and size collisions; never normalize away construction or duplicate-removal work.

experiments.title: Slope and real-part restrictions
experiments.question: Does restricting u and m=z/v help beyond a rational parametrization of X=m^2-2u?
experiments.arms: u in U and m in M, H in {2,4,8}; enforce 4dv^2=Delta_T(m); add independent v restriction as an ablation.
experiments.controls: Same quartic witness written entirely over Fp; exact-F table; ordinary low-degree addition witnesses.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Projected solution-set equality first; then encoding size and counted work per independent row.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: If the candidate and rational witness systems are identical after renaming, classify the result as encoding reuse rather than new twist geometry.

experiments.title: Norm and multiplicative restrictions
experiments.question: Can norm constraints or multiplicative structure reduce solve cost after parameterization and membership are charged?
experiments.arms: Norm(x)=u^2-dv^2 in W; norm(y) restrictions; H-th-power or subgroup conditions only when H divides p-1; intersect with a trace-box family.
experiments.controls: Same F without norm witnesses; same-size rational base; matched subgroup-size control; nonsquare d rescaling.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Image size, membership degree/selector size, projection collisions and complete stage work.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Unchanged projected sets at unchanged or higher cost close only that restriction; missing roots do not count as a win.

experiments.title: Divisors and degree-two places
experiments.question: Can generic conjugate pairs help smooth-divisor relations when the principal pure-twist pairs are removed?
experiments.arms: Sparse rational functions a(x)+y b(x), coefficient support frozen; distinguish x in Fp from genuinely nonrational degree-two places.
experiments.controls: Remove divisors of x-x0 before forming rows; rational-only function family; generic degree-two-place control.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Factoring and lifting work, nontrivial projected divisor rows, row span and failed factorizations.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Principal pairs and empty projected rows are not relations; retain the full degree and coefficient-height budgets.

experiments.title: Exact relation census
experiments.question: Which restricted bases actually span the needed target rows?
experiments.arms: m in {2,3,4}, B in {8,12,16}; all nonidentity targets for tiny fixtures; freeze sign/orbit conventions.
experiments.controls: Complete enumeration or MITM oracle; identical projected base and target; raw versus canonicalized rows.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Exact relation set, target coverage, rank over r, target-row span and verified known-answer recovery.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Do not silently replace unattainable full-column rank with a new stopping rule; freeze target-span stopping in advance.

experiments.title: Equivalent system builders
experiments.question: Which membership representation avoids merely moving cost into a higher-degree constraint?
experiments.arms: Univariate product membership, bit decomposition with proven range, selector/product chains and explicit branching.
experiments.controls: Untwisted addition chain; exact same projected F; independently enumerated projected solutions.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Equality of full projected sets including multiplicity/sign policy and exceptional branches; equations/variables/degrees.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: A mismatch blocks all solver comparisons until repaired; coefficient fields and modular-wrap conditions are part of the input.

experiments.title: Solver and ordering panel
experiments.question: Does symmetry reduce actual solving cost against the strongest equivalent encoding?
experiments.arms: Frozen variable orders, chain/quadratized/symmetric encodings; msolve/open reference plus available applicable F4/F5 engines.
experiments.controls: A/A runs; untwisted witness system; redundant-variable positive/negative controls; same output verifier.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Counted native operations, Macaulay dimensions/nnz, reductions, solving degree, memory, failures and cost per useful row.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Lower displayed degree alone is not a win; timeouts and OOMs remain incomplete outcomes under the same envelope.

experiments.title: Torsion over extensions
experiments.question: Can torsion symmetry survive Galois descent without false factor-base compression?
experiments.arms: 2-torsion over Fp^3 and combined Fp^6 where applicable; Galois-invariant coordinates and descent constraints.
experiments.controls: No-torsion encoding; [2] map on the odd subgroup; retained extension-field cost; rational torsion special-family control.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Equivalence, actual orbit/image size, descended system degree and complete representation cost.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: A geometric torsion orbit that leaves the rational base is not a rational factor-base quotient.
prerequisites: registered extension models and torsion verification

experiments.title: Explicit degree-two covers
experiments.question: When is the complementary elliptic quotient actually the required twist?
experiments.arms: C_c: v^2=f(u^2+c), f(c)!=0; quotient E and D_c: z^2=t f(t+c); use the explicit short complement coefficients.
experiments.controls: Reject f(c)=0; same-j only control; trace-opposite only control; explicit Fp isomorphism check.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Smoothness/genus, complete quotient maps including infinity, complement trace/j, isomorphism and image size.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Neither matching j nor opposite trace alone certifies the requested isomorphism or subgroup transfer.

experiments.title: Gluing and alternative complements
experiments.question: Do other gluing orders or complementary-factor constructions provide a better executable route?
experiments.arms: Galois-equivariant 2/3-torsion gluing where applicable; recover the complement from a supplied cover; bounded typed candidate families.
experiments.controls: Degenerate/product polarization control; incompatible Frobenius control; identical-field checks.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Actual curve/map construction, indecomposable polarization, subgroup kernel, factored evaluation cost and failures.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: A rejected family or failed bounded search does not establish universal nonexistence.

experiments.title: Jacobian arithmetic and recovery
experiments.question: Does the proposed transfer work on the divisor classes the collector actually produces?
experiments.arms: Pullback/norm on the chosen infinity model; arbitrary valid reduced classes; image subgroup order and recovery.
experiments.controls: phi_*phi^*=[degree]; origin and ramified fibers; independent CAS; direct-E solver.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Exact group-law and kernel/recovery checks; separate setup, maps, arithmetic and recovery costs.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Unsupported two-infinity or arbitrary-class arithmetic remains unsupported, not approximated by rational point-class tests.

experiments.title: Restricted cover images
experiments.question: Can restricting cover points give a small base without a worse membership or map problem?
experiments.arms: All-C(Fp) control; restricted u/trace/norm supports; degree/genus ladder only with frozen factored maps.
experiments.controls: Same projected base on E; fixed-genus image bound; independent point counts.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Actual image size, g/degree/representation size, construction and membership cost, projected rows.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: A fixed bounded-degree cover with order-p image does not supply a small base merely by changing the ambient variety.

experiments.title: Model and isogeny ablations
experiments.question: Are any savings due to cheaper constants or another isogenous representative rather than new relations?
experiments.arms: Nonsquare d choices, x-preserving/standard twist models, fixed small-degree rational isogeny routes and verified return maps.
experiments.controls: Equivalent direct-E representation; same source target/subgroup; conversion charged both ways.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Identical recovered outputs and projected relation policy; map, primitive and solver cost separated.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Different j or field models require typed identities; do not infer an unknown-scalar speedup from faster known-scalar multiplication.

experiments.title: Factorial pipeline ablation
experiments.question: Which component or combination improves the actual IC baseline?
experiments.arms: Trace restriction on/off, cover on/off, solver symmetry on/off; pairs use equal target/base or explicitly separate changed-base studies.
experiments.controls: Strongest current IC baseline; strongest same-target rho; direct destination generic solver; independent holdouts.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Cold single-target complete counted cost and S; setup/online split; 0/0.1/1 GAE pricing band; verification and replay.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: Every claimed IC improvement needs baseline/candidate >1 with all phases; rho is a reported gap, not the IC improvement pass gate.

experiments.title: Homomorphism and pairing applicability
experiments.question: Do small twist factors or a pairing actually supply an admissible transfer on the original subgroup?
experiments.arms: Exact gcd(r,#E_tw), embedding-degree and torsion/Frobenius tests on the declared public parameters.
experiments.controls: Trace/norm killing pure anti-invariants; translated-coset control; known small-embedding-degree positive family kept separate.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Exact applicability certificates and a named nondegenerate transfer if one exists.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: A smooth twist order or shared x-coordinate relation does not supply a subgroup-preserving transfer; do not run a nonexistent destination attack.

experiments.title: Arithmetic lift and twist ingress
experiments.question: Could a characteristic-zero twist reduce to E while providing a usable small-height relation source?
experiments.arms: Only twists whose parameter is square mod p for a same-E reduction; bounded height/rank/search families stated before a pilot.
experiments.controls: Nonsquare reduction goes to the other finite-field component; fixed-lift and equal-height controls; charge discovery and target lifting.
experiments.measurement_and_acceptance: Explicit reduction map, target lift, relation independence, heights and construction/search costs before any solver comparison.
experiments.stop_and_interpretation: High rank alone is not a cheap target lift or a speedup; no unbounded rank or designer-secret assumption is treated as evidence.
prerequisites: separate arithmetic-lift construction and height protocol
